summary: DevRelay 0.10.0-rc.3 is a released deterministic source/installable library operated through ChatGPT/Codex Desktop on Windows. RP-001 must define ReleasePreparation and ReleaseVerification through the full released lifecycle without reopening the published release or weakening Core, Gate, EnvironmentPreparation, evidence, or protected-main authority.
stakeholders: Module, adapter, host, release, and verification authors
Open-source contributors, reviewers, and downstream consumers
domainConstraints: ProjectMemory, the exact project-wide baseline pair, and bounded TraceabilityGraph context load before this lifecycle slice.
Every already-released upstream module runs before RP-001 is appended or integrated.
Accepted EnvironmentPreparation readiness receipts are required before every execution frontier.
Core remains provider-neutral; adapters may perform only explicitly bound release preparation or verification capabilities.
Release evidence must be source-preserving, digest-bound, redacted, checkpointed, and replayable.
The published 0.10.0-rc.3 assets must not be rebuilt, replaced, or used as mutable candidate outputs.
conventions: Ask clarification questions in breadth-first waves.
Require weighted closure of at least 0.99 and 0.99 confidence for every blocking domain.
Present qualitative additions and replacements before RequirementsGate promotion.
Use exact checkpoints and zero-call replay for effectful release preparation.
State adapter maturity from exact execution evidence rather than schemas or fixtures.
